verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox stores scanned mail and account data, so an AI-training opt-out or a no-training commitment is a fair privacy question for this kind of service. The evidence pack contains no policy, setting, or statement about AI model training or data-use restrictions. The probes (llms.txt, OpenAPI) are unrelated to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
